title: /admin — every page, every viewport, plus safe owner journeys
objective: Rick's entire surface: every admin GET page inspected at all 4 viewports (he uses whatever device is nearby), plus scripted owner journeys that exercise the forms — with the mirror restored afterwards. Anything that loses or misrepresents his typed work is severity A. Visual bar: the admin must be legible and operable, not beautiful — flag broken/overlapping/clipped, not unfashionable.

safety_contract.mirror_only: everything runs against _harness/site on :8123 (password audit-pass-123). NEVER against data/ in the repo — the working copy of live customer state.
safety_contract.restore: after ANY journey that saves: restore _harness/site/data/*.json from _harness/pristine/, byte-identical (cmp), and record mirror_restored=true in the ledger. plan9-firstsave.js and aud9-clearrepro.js show the restore pattern.
safety_contract.form_complete: content.php's form_complete is the LAST control (invariant 6). You read forms; you never alter their field sets.

steps.do: Review every screenshot in current/<all 4 viewports>/admin_*.png (re-crawl with --admin-only if the container is fresh). Same fan-out + verify method as pass-1. Rubric: form grids aligned; labels attached to their controls (click the label, focus must land); no clipped inputs/buttons at 390/834; tables (inquiries, audit-log, backups) readable or scrollable-in-place without page-level horizontal scroll; the health banner region; flash messages visible above the fold after redirects.

Signed-out surface: login screen at 4 viewports; a deep admin URL while signed out (must land on login, not a broken page); the no-password state is NOT tested (would require deleting the credential mid-pass).

Journey A — content edit round-trip: sign in, content.php, change one heading, Save, verify green banner + the change on the public site + prefilled Site Images values (PLAN-9 item 1 behavior). Screenshot each step at desktop-1440.
Journey B — validation display: submit settings.php with a deliberately bad brand color and a blank required-ish field; the error rendering (placement, contrast, focus) is the subject. Then restore.

Journey C — two-tab conflict banner: open content.php in two tabs, save both; the second must show the optimistic-concurrency message. The MESSAGE PRESENTATION is the subject (is it visible, comprehensible, does it name what happened) — the mechanism is known-green (plan4-admin).
Journey D — upload refusal display: attempt a fake-image upload (wrong bytes, right extension) on edit.php; the error message rendering is the subject. Restore uploads state if anything landed.

Sweep every admin page for: console errors, mixed-viewport meta issues, unstyled-flash-of-content, PHP notices/warnings leaking into the page (display_errors=On on :8123 — anything printed IS a finding), and title/breadcrumb-of-page correctness (each page names itself).
Restore mirror data from pristine (cmp-verified), update ledger (incl. mirror_restored), validate findings, commit 'audit10(pass-3): ...', push, delete _harness/site/admin/config.local.php.

recording: same as pass-1; severity per severity.json — lost/misrepresented typed work is A; a journey blocked by layout is B; clipped-but-operable is C
exit_criteria: 44 admin screenshots reviewed (11 pages x 4 viewports)
